tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground for all text. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, input fields and the baseline band behind trend lines. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and chart axis labels on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Dark rounded snapshot panel that holds the live vocal readout and mono label/value rows.

tokens.name: panel-ink
tokens.usage: Text on panel.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Wordmark, primary buttons and links on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: signal-fatigue
tokens.usage: Fatigue trend line and fatigue chips on surface-100 and surface-200. Draw it solid and thick; pair with signal-stress, which is dashed.

tokens.name: signal-stress
tokens.usage: Stress trend line on surface-100 and surface-200. Always draw it dashed so it separates from signal-fatigue without relying on hue.

tokens.name: state-baseline
tokens.usage: Within the person's own baseline. Always shown with the word Baseline. Fill or stroke on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: state-watch
tokens.usage: Drifting from baseline across recent calls. Always shown with the word Watch.

tokens.name: state-elevated
tokens.usage: Sustained shift from baseline. Always shown with the word Elevated.

tokens.name: state-high
tokens.usage: Strong, persistent shift. Always shown with the word High. Never the only cue; wellness signal, not a diagnosis.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, at least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: panel-fatigue
tokens.usage: Fatigue line and values on panel.

tokens.name: panel-stress
tokens.usage: Stress line and values on panel.

tokens.name: panel-good
tokens.usage: Baseline state marks on panel.

tokens.name: panel-alert
tokens.usage: Elevated and high state marks on panel.

styles.name: display-xl-italic
styles.usage: Second line of a hero headline.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker labels and eyebrows, for example AMPLIFIER FOR ZOOM.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live vocal readout values on the panel.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, between a headline and its lede.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and color blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and the dark snapshot panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pricing toggles and state pills.
